summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on Python test automation and systems-debugging experience across embedded and ML pipelines. Built and validated multi-component distributed systems end-to-end, applying software testing and validation methodologies and root cause analysis to resolve integration failures. Comfortable working independently in Linux environments, configuring TCP/IP networking, and collaborating across cross-functional, globally distributed teams.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI (PyQt, Matplotlib) for real-time data acquisition and experimental validation, applying structured software testing and validation methodologies in a laboratory test environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Improved model validation accuracy from 55% to 93% through iterative test automation development and debugging, preprocessing refinement, and model tuning.
Built and validated PyTorch preprocessing/training pipelines (HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder) for structured document field extraction.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained and validated a YOLOv8n object-detection model (83% mAP@50 on held-out validation set) using automated evaluation scripts; exported to ONNX/TFLite for deployment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) on a voice-controlled, vision-guided robotic system after resolving 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through systematic root cause analysis and debugging.

Built and validated a three-layer distributed system (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, Jetson+Arduino controller) unified over a TCP/IP-based WebSocket fabric, with static IP networking configuration for reliable multi-device communication.
Deployed the Jetson-side service via systemd (auto-restart, non-root isolation, environment-based config) in a headless Linux environment, administered remotely via XRDP.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Benchmarked an 8-bit quantized TinyLlama 1.1B model against HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC test suites, running regression testing against baseline results to confirm <1% accuracy degradation.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Built a custom BPE tokenizer with a Cython-accelerated backend achieving 4–5.5× speedup over pure Python, validated against a 15% WER benchmark on the NPTEL 2020 dataset.
